title: Agent Kim Reactivated
synopsis: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim is an ordinary salaryman whose biggest worry is how to connect with his daughter Kim Min-ji — until she suddenly goes missing.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.synopsis: With Manager Kim's mission a failure, the three agent dads team up with Sang-a to fight their way out — but Gang-chan has another trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.synopsis: Pushed to the brink by Gang-chan, Manager Kim must now make a crucial choice with Han-soo and Jin-cheol. Will Manager Kim be able to keep Min-ji safe?
